tickets.name: Out of the Huddle
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Cavaliers at Knicks, because the first minute is where the money is! Towns has to deal with Allen in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! Win that tip and the Cavaliers are first in line to score. Should Allen get the tip, the ball comes right back to him. First look, baby! If that first look rims out, Watson is right there to clean it up! Any one of them hits and the whole game is paid for. That's how we like it!

tickets.name: Off the Tip
tickets.note: Celtics at Raptors, and here's how we see the opening act! The jump ball goes Poeltl against Queta, and Poeltl has the springs tonight! That hands the Raptors the first possession, and that's half the battle! If Poeltl controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look! If the Celtics steal the tip or get the first stop, Queta is who we want firing first! And Walsh is the second option on that same trip, and the price is a beauty! One bucket from any of them and we're cashing. Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

Wide open at the start, and we're riding the Nuggets! Tip it, run it, finish it. If Jokic gets that jump, that's the whole plan! Gordon is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! And Johnson sneaks in as the third man, just in case! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!
